jobs.title: Social Media Content Producer
jobs.description:
**Job Title: Social Media Content Producer**

**Location:** Remote, U.S.  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Reports To:** Marketing Director

Foodees is seeking a hands\-on Social Media Content Producer to create, publish, and manage engaging organic content across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts, FoodeesNation, and other approved platforms.

Foodees produces large, three\-day food festivals across the United States featuring food trucks, tented food vendors, artisans, crafters, and local businesses. This role will help bring the Foodees brand to life, support event attendance and vendor recruitment, and provide a steady pipeline of content for both organic social media and paid advertising.

**Responsibilities**

* Create and publish platform\-specific content, including captions, short\-form videos, stories, graphics, vendor features, event promotions, countdowns, and recaps.
* Build and maintain content calendars aligned with Foodees’ event schedule and marketing priorities.
* Edit short\-form video for Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and paid\-media testing.
* Create basic branded graphics and content adaptations using Canva or similar tools.
* Schedule and publish content across all social platforms.
* Monitor comments, messages, tags, and engagement while responding in a professional, brand\-appropriate manner.
* Collaborate with the Marketing Director, Senior Media Buyer, graphic designers, video editors, and event teams.
* Help maintain a consistent supply of creative assets for Meta, Google, and YouTube advertising.
* Assist with influencer outreach and coordination.
* Organize and maintain Foodees’ photo, video, and content library.
* Stay current on platform trends, updates, and audience behavior.
* Travel to selected Foodees events may occasionally be required.
* Develop content ideas based on current social media trends, platform best practices, and audience insights.
* Identify opportunities to create engaging, non\-promotional content that builds community around the Foodees brand. \-Recommend new content series, influencers and platform specific strategies that increase engagement and reach.
* Proven understanding of what makes content perform organically on different social platforms.

**Qualifications**

* 2\+ years of professional social media or content production experience.
* Strong copywriting, storytelling, proofreading, and communication skills.
* Hands\-on experience creating and editing short\-form video.
* Experience with Canva and basic graphic design.
* Strong understanding of Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube.
* Experience with Meta Business Suite or other scheduling platforms.
* Highly organized and able to manage multiple events, platforms, and deadlines.
* Self\-starter with strong attention to detail.

**Preferred Experience**

Experience with festivals, events, food, hospitality, tourism, lifestyle brands, or community\-focused organizations is preferred. Experience supporting paid advertising creative, influencer programs, CapCut, Adobe tools, or content\-library management is also beneficial.

**Portfolio Required**

Applicants must submit examples of social media content they personally created, including short\-form video, graphics, captions, or brand accounts they directly managed.

**About Foodees**

Foodees produces free\-admission, family\-friendly food festivals throughout the United States. Our events bring communities together through food, art, small business, and shared experiences.

Pay: $54,122\.10 \- $65,179\.30 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Principal Internal Communications Manager
jobs.description:
**Who we are**



At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.



Our dedication to remote\-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.  

.


**Hiring and how we work :**



We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!



Also, while we are a remote\-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad\-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off\-sites or customer meetings.  

.

**See yourself at Twilio**



Join the team as Twilio’s next Principal Internal Communications Manager, a high\-impact, individual contributor leadership role reporting to and working in close partnership with the Internal Communications Lead.


**About the job**



Twilio’s Internal Communications team is seeking an experienced, strategic, and highly collaborative Principal Internal Communications Manager to serve as a cornerstone of our global IC function. In this role, you will act as a primary thought partner to the team lead on overarching program strategy and execution, while taking direct ownership of our most critical, sensitive, and high\-stakes employee communications. Your work will be integral to protecting Twilio's culture, aligning our workforce, and navigating complex corporate moments for our 5,500 Twilions around the world.



This Twilion will have world\-class strategic acumen, impeccable discretion, and a calm, steady demeanor under pressure. You are a seasoned expert at navigating complex corporate, legal, and social environments, possessing the rare ability to translate high\-stakes business realities into empathetic, clear, and highly effective internal narratives.


**Responsibilities**



In this role, you’ll:


* **Partner on Global IC Strategy:** Work in close partnership with the Internal Communications Lead to co\-architect the overarching strategic direction and execution of the wider internal communications program.
* **Partner closely with PR/External Comms:** Serve as point of contact with external comms team during strategic projects and crises, ensuring internal and external narratives stay aligned and sequenced.
* **Lead highly sensitive employee communications:** Own the end\-to\-end strategy, narrative creation, and execution for high\-stakes, sensitive corporate scenarios, ensuring absolute confidentiality, accuracy, and cultural alignment. Including but not limited to employment legal issues, ethics and misconduct cases, regulatory or legal actions, and safety \& security incidents.
* **Manage transactional \& structural change comms:** Drive the internal communication strategy for complex corporate evolutions, including Mergers \& Acquisitions (M\&A), strategic transactions, organizational redesigns, and executive transitions
* **Advise on social Issues:** Provide strategic counsel and develop thoughtful framework\-driven messaging regarding complex external political and social issues, balancing company values with employee sentiment.
* **Collaborate cross functionally:** Partner deeply with Legal, HR, Employee Relations, Security, and Corporate Affairs to operationalize communications around sensitive matters, ensuring a unified, legally compliant, and compassionate voice.
* **Support finance communications:** Partner with the Finance org and ghostwrite for the CFO on both companywide financial moments (earnings, financial updates) and the CFO's internal comms to the finance org, including quarterly updates and finance org all hands.
* **Flex across the IC portfolio:** When there isn’t an active strategic project or crisis, plug into the broader work of the team (Q\&A prep, All Hands support, comms campaigns, etc.) and whatever else needs a strong writer and thinker.


**Qualifications**



Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!


* **Required:**


* **In\-Role experience:** 10\+ years of experience in internal communications, corporate communications, or crisis management, with a proven track record operating at a principal or senior manager level within a global technology company.
* **Strategic partnership and execution:** Demonstrated experience acting as a trusted right\-hand to communications leadership, helping to steer broader program strategy while simultaneously executing on the ground.
* **Crisis \& sensitive comms expertise:** Deep, hands\-on experience managing highly confidential and sensitive communications, particularly around M\&A, restructuring, legal actions, and complex workplace issues.
* **Executive presence and discretion:** Exceptional emotional intelligence, commanding poise under pressure, and the ability to interface with and influence C\-suite executives and legal counsel on highly sensitive matters.
* **Project management:** Very comfortable moving between strategic and tactical work, holding multiple projects to deadline, managing stakeholders, keeping partners informed, etc. Strong operational muscle to complement the strategic and creative work.
* **Ghostwriting range:** Proven ability to write in the voice of a variety of leaders, often for people you don’t work with daily and with limited advance notice. Quick study on tone, c
